full_judgment: 3. The learned Magistrate took cognizance of the offence. At the trial the prosecution examined 4 witness and the defence none. The learned Magistrate found the accused petitioner not guilty of the offence under section 500 of the penal code and passed an order of acquittal. On appeal the High Court Division discussed the evidence on record the answer the respondent’s contention that the trial Court’s judgment is based on misreading of evidence. The High Court Division found that there is no evidence that any fund was ever collected under the control of the respondent as vice President and also that the trial on a misreading of the evidence of p.ws 144. The High Court Division discussed the essential ingredients of an offence under section 499 of the penal Code and found that all the ingredients are attracted in the light of the evidence on record and that the publication in questions to  section 499 of the penal code. Accordingly the judgment and order of acquittal was set aside and the accused-petitioner was convicted and sentenced by the High Court Division as aforesaid.
